answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk forgery. A slot costs a 200 POA burn, marked by an onyx token on a mesa-high post. A forger minting 1,000 fakes must burn 200,000 POA. The reward pool is fixed at 150,000 POA, so at 1,500 slots each earns 100 POA: 1,000 fakes return 100,000 POA on a 200,000 POA burn. Honest agents pay once, hold it 20 epochs, and earn 300 POA per epoch, repaid in one epoch, like saffron planted once, harvested for seasons.
